flags.why: A phảng is a broad-bladed grass-clearing tool, whereas 'sickle' teaches a different tool ([description](https://baocantho.com.vn/cong-cu-lao-dong-xua-o-nam-bo-a121153.html)).
flags.fix: long-handled, broad-bladed cutting tool for clearing grass
